- After instance logs are associated with LTS log flows, the background automatically uploads instance logs to the associated LTS log flows. - After the association is successful, a fee will be charged. For details about the charging, see the pricing details of the Cloud Log Service (LTS). - The system creates a structured configuration of the log type for the current log flow. If the structured configuration of other log types already exists for the log flow, the system overwrites the configuration.
